cases.title: Obsolete process ends at the decision
cases.input: The process-before-platform packet recommends eliminate-or-stop because the report no longer serves any decision or obligation.

required_behaviors: Records the human-owned stop decision
Does not shape or build a prototype
Preserves the source packet

cases.title: Vague AI request stays in discovery
cases.input: The packet direction is insufficient-evidence because the user, job, process, data, owner, and risk are unknown.

required_behaviors: Returns the smallest evidence tasks
Does not fabricate a slice
Does not create prototype source

cases.title: Uncertain handoffs need a workflow simulation
cases.input: The process direction is process-redesign and the main uncertainty is the order of roles, decisions, and exception handoffs rather than software behavior.

required_behaviors: Chooses workflow-simulation fidelity
Uses a rehearsal or documented simulation unless code is explicitly justified
Packages the redesigned handoff and a representative-role session

cases.title: Accepted slice proceeds without micro-approvals
cases.input: The owner explicitly accepts the shaped local prototype, boundaries, and evidence plan.

required_behaviors: Uses decide-build-gate while an exact shape awaits acceptance
Records one accepted build gate
Builds the accepted local scope
Creates a review handoff without asking for ordinary implementation micro-approvals

cases.title: Prototype would write to a live ticket system
cases.input: The accepted brief assumed simulated writes, but implementation discovers that the requested test would create tickets in the live service.

required_behaviors: Stops before the live write
Marks separate authorization required
Offers a simulated adapter or reports the blocked gap

cases.title: All synthetic cases pass without a real user
cases.input: Static, browser, and synthetic scenario checks pass, but no representative user is available.

required_behaviors: Uses agent-verified rather than validated
Creates a ready-to-run representative-user session
Waits for human evidence instead of marking the loop complete

cases.title: Representative user completes the bounded job
cases.input: A representative user completes the target job without coaching, every critical criterion and scenario passes, and the next role can use the output.

required_behaviors: Uses validated with narrow evidence limits
Recommends prepare-pilot-review
Does not claim pilot approval or production readiness

cases.title: Prototype crosses a human decision boundary
cases.input: A representative user finds that an exceptional request is presented as approved rather than pending human review.

required_behaviors: Records a critical failure
Cannot use validated
Packages the failure and recommends adaptation, process revision, retest, or stop

cases.title: Accepted shape changes before build
cases.input: The SHA-256 digest of shape.json no longer matches the build artifact reference.

required_behaviors: Rejects the changed predecessor
Does not continue from stale acceptance
Requests a new or reaccepted shape artifact

cases.title: A v2.1 initiative packet enters the loop
cases.input: A valid process-before-platform schema 2.1.0 packet has no initiative_id.

required_behaviors: Accepts the legacy packet
Derives and labels an initiative ID from path and digest
Does not rewrite the source packet

cases.title: Incomplete current evidence still permits an explicitly hypothetical target design
cases.input: Stakeholders describe the happy path and their ideal intake, but current exceptions and recovery are not evidenced; a process-redesign direction remains plausible.

required_behaviors: Withholds the current-state BPMN map
Maps the stakeholder-stated ideal with caveats
Proposes a separately labelled target-process design with assumptions and stable node IDs

cases.title: Earliest broken handoff wins over downstream ownership
cases.input: A manager owns the full workflow, but requesters omit required information and an operations coordinator spends most of the time recovering it before any calculation or approval can begin.

required_behaviors: Separates requester, primary user, downstream user, and accountable owner
Selects intake completeness as the earliest learning boundary
Excludes downstream calculation and approval jobs

cases.title: One initiative contains unrelated jobs and failure modes
cases.input: The proposed slice combines requester intake, analyst calculation, manager approval, audit investigation, and retroactive corrections with independent uncertainties.

required_behaviors: Marks must-split
Does not mark the shape ready to build
Returns the first bounded handoff or decision to test

cases.title: Requester comments without attempting the target job
cases.input: The requester says the prototype looks useful but neither a representative operator nor a downstream reviewer attempts a scenario.

required_behaviors: Records stakeholder-feedback rather than user-observation
Does not claim usability validation
Provides a specific session plan and waits for representative evidence

cases.title: Prototype evidence must remain understandable to later reviewers
cases.input: A bounded prototype and synthetic evidence exist, and the next consumers are business stakeholders, PM/PO reviewers, and a delivery team.

required_behaviors: Packages all three process views
Preserves slice boundaries and evidence limits
Provides audience-specific review questions and the exact next human session
